management_liability.description: Personal liability for governing body members. Mandatory training to identify risks. Cybersecurity-responsible person must be appointed independently from Head of IT within 30 days of DNSC identification.

csirt.name: DNSC
csirt.note: DNSC serves as both competent authority and national CSIRT (formerly CERT-RO)

compliance_deadlines.registration: 2025-09-19 (30 days from DNSC orders taking effect)

penalties.essential_entities: EUR 10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover
penalties.important_entities: EUR 7,000,000 or 1.4% of global annual turnover
penalties.note: Penalties increase by 50% for repeated violations
